description: Defines data structures and functions for quantized weight packing and unpacking, specifically for FBGEMM optimized operations in PyTorch, including classes for packed linear and convolution weights, and embedding bag weights.

classes.name: PackedLinearWeight
classes.description: Represents a packed weight matrix for linear layers with methods for applying quantized operations.

classes.name: PackedLinearWeightFp16
classes.description: Represents a packed weight matrix for linear layers in FP16 format.

classes.name: PackedConvWeight
classes.description: Represents a packed weight for convolutional layers with quantization support.

classes.name: PackedEmbeddingBagWeight
classes.description: Represents a packed embedding bag weight with quantization parameters.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the packed weight to an input tensor, producing a quantized output.

methods.name: apply_relu
methods.description: Applies the packed weight with ReLU activation.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Unpacks the weight to retrieve original parameters.

methods.name: prepack
methods.description: Prepares and packs a weight tensor for optimized inference.

methods.name: set_bias
methods.description: Sets the bias tensor for the packed weight.

methods.name: embeddingbag_byte
methods.description: Performs embedding bag operation with byte quantized weights.

methods.name: embeddingbag_4bit
methods.description: Performs embedding bag operation with 4-bit quantized weights.
